acceptance: Workspace fmt, Clippy, tests, rustdoc strict, shell/web/embedded profiles and MSRV 1.96 are green.
Conformance corpus passes on VM and Reg with identical output; JS parity and the documented Wasm subset are recorded.
Game host, Poppy, eGUI, C ABI header sync and package tests pass.
README, CHANGELOG, PROJECT_STATE, backend matrix and progress panel describe v0.1.0 without overclaiming parity.
Prumo validate and doctor finish cleanly.
Tag v0.1.0 and a GitHub release are published with the certified commit and known limitations.
Evidence records link the release to the test, docs and repository revision.
constraints: Do not publish or tag before all quality gates are green.
Do not claim Wasm, Reg or cross-platform parity beyond measured evidence.
Record skipped fuzz/Miri/ASan and historical performance limits explicitly.
No secrets or credentials in release artifacts.
non_goals: Full Wasm parity beyond the documented subset.
Full Reg native parity for higher-order methods and failure handlers.
Fuzz, Miri and ASan certification in this release.
Post-v1 engines, editors and public package registry.
objective: Certify and publish Aipo v0.1.0 with green quality gates, clean Prumo validate/doctor, reconciled documentation, reproducible artifacts and signed evidence.
title: Release v0.1.0 certification
